summary: Two defects found by inspection: selecting a release bundle makes the default build fail its own tests, and starred graphics commands bypass the required path restriction. All four check commands remain NOT_RUN because execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC1: Article class, repository style, packages, fonts, title, authors and empty date
checks.evidence: paper/main.tex:1-12 declares the required class, style, working title, Gradient Descent and empty date. paper/arxiv.sty:3-20 contains the small package configuration with the required geometry and packages, without fontenc or inputenc.

checks.criterion: AC2: Empty manuscript skeleton and required include order
checks.evidence: paper/main.tex:4 and :18-35 contain the required inputs in order. Each section and appendix file contains only its required section and label. Reading abstract.tex showed 0 bytes; the tracked paper file list contains no Appendix C.

checks.criterion: AC3: Deterministic generated macros and header-only committed artifact
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/numbers.py:39-55 defines the spec and empty MACROS; :163-170 writes bytes atomically. paper/generated/numbers.tex contains exactly the required two comments, and its byte dump showed LF endings and a trailing newline. Generator execution and repeated-output verification were prohibited by the read-only review.

checks.criterion: AC4: Production bundle validation, provenance, invalid-value rejection and preservation on failure
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/numbers.py:98-110 rejects invalid numeric values; :132 calls validate_bundle with production=True; :135-159 records provenance and resolves listed inputs; :193-198 prevents writing on reported errors. Runtime validation and output-preservation checks require execution prohibited by this review.

checks.criterion: AC5: Test-first numbers tests and required temporary-bundle coverage
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/test_numbers.py:54-69 constructs the required temporary bundles; :111-349 covers the specified success and failure cases. Git tree inspection showed test_numbers.py existed before numbers.py. Its historical failing execution and current test results cannot be independently verified without relying on excluded logs or running prohibited checks.

checks.criterion: AC6: Test-first manuscript rules with positive and negative examples
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/test_manuscript.py:443 recognizes only unstarred includegraphics. Consequently the guard at :463-465 ignores a valid starred command such as \includegraphics*{../external.pdf}, allowing graphics outside figures/generated/. Tests at :501-517 cover only the unstarred form.

checks.criterion: AC7: Post-Tectonic log gate and pattern tests
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/check_log.py:24-46 defines the required patterns and :65-105 applies them to log and optional blg files. paper/scripts/test_check_log.py:44-190 supplies clean, failing and boundary excerpts. Running these tests or a Tectonic build was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC8: Makefile targets, bundle selection, pinned Tectonic bundle and existing Python toolchain
checks.evidence: paper/Makefile:18-25 makes all generate numbers from BUNDLE_VERSION before running tests. paper/scripts/numbers.py:138-140 then writes a release source line, while paper/scripts/test_numbers.py:130-131 unconditionally requires the no-bundle source line. Thus a valid selected bundle makes the default build fail before pdf.

checks.criterion: AC9: Ignored build outputs, short README, protected root files and proposed instructions
checks.evidence: .gitignore:41-49 ignores the required outputs; no Tectonic output appears in the tracked paper tree. paper/README.md:7-22 contains the prerequisites, pinned bundle, generated-file policy and commands. The listed story commits leave the protected root files unchanged. Successful execution of every documented command was not independently verified because checks were prohibited.

checks.criterion: Required check: lint, formatting and strict typing
checks.evidence: User explicitly prohibited running checks in the read-only sandbox; tool and cache writes are unavailable.
User explicitly prohibited running checks; this target creates and removes a temporary output file.
User explicitly prohibited running checks; the suite writes temporary bundles, outputs and test caches.
User explicitly prohibited running checks; this target regenerates numbers, runs tests and writes Tectonic outputs.

findings.claim: The header-only artifact assertion prevents the default build from accepting any valid BUNDLE_VERSION.
findings.evidence: paper/Makefile:18-25 regenerates generated/numbers.tex from the selected bundle before test. numbers.py:138-140 writes the required release-version and manifest-hash source line, but test_numbers.py:130-131 requires that same working-tree file to equal NO_BUNDLE. This contradiction stops the build before pdf even when MACROS is empty. Test no-bundle output in a temporary file and cover the bundle-enabled build sequence.

findings.claim: Starred includegraphics commands bypass the required generated-PDF path guard.
findings.evidence: INCLUDEGRAPHICS requires whitespace, options or an opening brace immediately after the command name, so it cannot capture \includegraphics*{../external.pdf}. disallowed_graphics at :463-465 checks only captured paths and therefore reports no violation. The raster scan cannot enforce the required PDF location either. Recognize the starred form and add allowed/disallowed examples for it.
